newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Red October 1996 IAS net 33.3 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russia Red October 1996 IAS net 33.3 bln rbls.

text.p: NOTES -- Full company name is OAO Moskovskaya Konditerskaya Fabrika Krasny Oktyabr (Red October). Figures prepared to international accounting standards by Coopers & Lybrand.

Red October previously posted 127.8 billion roubles net profits in 1996 to Russian accounting standards against 136.5 billion roubles in 1995. It said pre-tax profit to Russian standards in 1996 was 167.8 billion roubles after 185 billion.
It also said previously it raised 1996 dividends to 1,900 roubles per ordinary share with a face value of 1,000 roubles from 1,800 roubles paid on 1995 results.

Company president Anatoly Daursky said earlier this year it would raise production in 1997 to 72,000 tonnes from 58,000 tonnes in 1996 with the start of production at a new factory with a 7,500 tonne capacity.
Red October plans to issue about 1.5 million preferred shares and a $20 million Eurobond.
